insight.wind-line-archer.name: Wind-Line Archer
insight.wind-line-archer.why: Owned ranged weapon attacks through a Current remove only long-range Disadvantage; one hit each turn may move a legal-sized target five feet in its recorded direction.

insight.cloud-step-novice.name: Cloud-Step Novice
insight.cloud-step-novice.why: Self Feather-Fall Breath permits ten feet horizontal drift before landing; one unsupported end-turn fall per scene may be delayed through the next turn's end.
